title: Notice on Change in Tokenomics: IOTA (IOTA)

For more context and details, please refer to the information provided by the project team as per link(s) below: https://x.com/iota/status/1871182525386903717 https://x.com/iota/status/1858510529976762695 	 Risk warning pop up and banner will also be displayed on the  Binance trading page . Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support!
